note: Hand-authored against real ax-harness content. These are representative of the mechanical share of agent work (retrieval, extraction, mechanical QA) — the jobs the policy routes to Token Factory. They are labelled as authored, not sampled: the replay supplies the real distribution, these supply the quality test.

fixtures.prompt: From the text below, answer only with the number of skills. Text: 'AX is an agent distro: a portable directory that holds your skills, your agents and your memory as plain Markdown. Currently 126 skills and 8 subagents.'
fixtures.rubric: Answer must contain 126 and must not contain 8 as the primary answer.

fixtures.prompt: From this config, reply with only the model tier assigned to code-review. Config: 'code-review: opus, core-investigator: sonnet, dreamer: sonnet, implementer: sonnet, learning-extractor: haiku, qa-test: haiku'
Reply with only the port number. Text: 'Zero-dep node:http server on AX_DASH_PORT (default 7777). Peer fan-out fetches over Tailscale with a 1200 ms timeout.'

fixtures.rubric: Must mention scoping mdfind and convey that unscoped is slow. One sentence.
